cards.t: Bitwise Launches First Spot NEAR ETF on NYSE Arca
cards.b: Bitwise has officially rolled out the first spot NEAR ETF on NYSE Arca, opening direct institutional access and driving major inflows into the asset.

per.NEAR: Major institutional tailwind from the first spot ETF launch on NYSE Arca, driving immediate market attention and liquidity.

cards.t: Concrete Token Hits Coinbase and OKX with Controlled Price Auctions
cards.b: Concrete (CT) is launching on Coinbase and OKX with structured price auctions, providing massive initial spot exposure and liquidity.

per.CT: Tier-1 exchange availability on Coinbase and OKX creates immediate price discovery and strong volume pressure.
